Thus equality iff all nonantipodal balanced and the antipodal inequality 4p(1−p)min{cos²φ,sin²φ}≥1/4. Independent Hermitian-operator Gram computations reproduced sharp min/max for N=3,…,7. This is analytical all-N proof, not extrapolation from tests.
